lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a rectilinear grid. Visible nodes form approximately five vertical columns and four horizontal rows anterior to the dorsal fin trauma site.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal carinae and the circular blobs, creating a grid-like lattice of anchor nodes across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, each defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive structural amputation of the first dorsal fin. A large, smooth, concave void occupies the central and posterior region of the fin, exposing high-luminance internal tissue and leaving only a thin, pointed anterior margin.
